answer: Builder's take: anchor each ID to its own Lightning node. Registration needs a signature from a node pubkey holding at least 2M sats in public channels to 3+ distinct peers, all open 90+ days; gossip data lets anyone check it. That capital stays locked like timber in a frame, so 100 sybils tie up 200M sats (2 BTC) plus open fees. Payouts route over those channels, and IDs whose channels all converge on one ridge hub get pooled into one share. Fresh nodes shift like a dune and earn nothing. (Thresholds proposed, unmeasured.)
